notes: I have no shell or git tool, so I could not produce the 77fffdb..0408826 diff. I identified the delta from the sprint plan (docs/plans/phase-a-refine/sprint-r-6-session-log-record.md) and read the touched files in full or in the relevant regions. Those were ids.rs (SessionId, AnswerId, Sha256Digest::of_text), observability/v2.rs (LogEvent), git.rs (discover_common_dir), run/log.rs (new), run/mod.rs, session/mod.rs, host compose.rs and obs.rs, and the sc-jev-py project plumbing. Untouched r-7 code was not reviewed.
HEAD check: the worktree HEAD is refs/heads/sprint/r-6-session-log-record, and that ref resolves to 040882616616a60326510c22d5be38d02116ac06, which matches the assigned commit 0408826.

RBP-001: the new failure paths are structured JevError constructors with fix hints. These are non-ULID or UUID session ids (INPUT_INVALID), a v2 session document (session_document_invalid), and an over-long or control-character project label (INPUT_INVALID). The silent fallbacks, `unwrap_or_else(|_| config.repo_root.clone())` in SendLog::new and the `Ok(Some(..))` guard in discover_main_repo_root, are documented best-effort log paths and do not lose a user-visible error.

RBP-004: SessionId, AnswerId, ProjectLabel and Operation are validated newtypes, and parse_ulid is the one strict parser, so no validation is repeated. RepoRoot is now used for both the worktree toplevel and the logged main-repo root. The plan binds discover_main_repo_root to return RepoRoot, so I did not raise it.
RBP-006: no new Cell or RefCell. The Mutex in obs.rs is the process-wide logger registry, documented in the module docs and poison-tolerant.
RBP-007: the unreachable! arm in Sha256Digest::of_text is a `&str`-guarded bug path, as D0 specifies. discover_main_repo_root returns Result only because its fallback to discover_repo_root can fail.
RBP-003 and RBP-008: SessionLog is documented as an intentionally open, object-safe port. LogEvent stays a concrete struct with private fields. No new pub trait was added.
RBP-009: the per-send clones (repo String, question ids, digest) are small and not on a hot path, so no Cow change is warranted.

Unsolicited and not a finding: `FileSessionStore::path`, `load` and `read_document` take `&SessionId` although SessionId is now Copy, and `LogEvent::session_id()` returns a reference. This is API style only, and changing it would break existing signatures.
